description.html: This nautical decoration shows the wheel of a sunken ship surrounded by barrels that fell from the deck. The wheel has a warm, golden-brown tone with wood grain, and two barrels lie in front of it: one yellow-green, the other reddish-brown with dark hoops. The base is covered in a green, moss-like texture, so the decoration looks as if it has been on the bottom for a long time.

Both barrels are hollow and open, so fish can swim through them or rest inside. This way several fish can find their own spot at the same time, and smaller species and shrimp have somewhere to hide. It goes well with a pirate ship, shipwrecks and an anchor.

Before placing the decoration, rinse it with lukewarm water, without detergent. Set it on a flat bottom and press the base lightly into the gravel or sand. Turn the barrel openings toward the front glass or to the side, so fish have a clear passage and you can watch them. Remove algae from the wheel and barrels with a soft brush during regular aquarium cleaning.
